name: Actual Budget
description: A local-first personal finance tool. The server only syncs the encrypted budget files between devices; the data volume is what a backup has to carry.

access.note: Actual has no user accounts and no default password. The first page you open is a bootstrap screen that asks you to choose the server password, and that one password is how every device signs in. Whoever opens the address first sets it, so open it immediately after the deploy finishes.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The web app and sync API

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Budget files and the server's own database

update.notes: Server and app versions move together; update the browser app by reloading.
